info.title: binary-migrator - move Pleasanter binaries (attachments and images) between Rds, Local and AzureBlob.
info.description: Pleasanter に添付されたファイル（Binaries）の保管先を、Rds・Local・AzureBlob の間で移すコマンドラインツール。

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show what would be copied/skipped/deleted. Nothing is written or deleted.

options.name: --delete-source
options.description:
After a copy is verified (size and SHA-256 read back from the destination),
delete the source: Rds sets the column (Bin) to NULL, Local/AzureBlob delete
the object. Unverified items are never deleted. Requires --yes.

options.name: --yes
options.description: Confirm --delete-source.

options.name: --types
options.description: Comma-separated: attachments,images,siteimage,tenantimage (default: all).

options.name: --parallel
options.description: Concurrent copies, 1-16 (default: 1, serial).

options.name: --max-retries
options.description: Retries for transient failures, 0-10 (default: 3).

options.name: --quiet
options.description: Do not print one line per successful item.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help.

options.name: --version
options.description:
Show the version.
Rds source options (connects to the Pleasanter database directly):

options.name: --rds-dbms
options.description: sqlserver | postgresql | mysql   [env BINARY_MIGRATOR_RDS_DBMS]

options.name: --rds-connection-string-file
options.description: Read the connection string from a file.

options.name: --rds-connection-string-stdin
options.description:
Read the connection string from standard input.
(default: env BINARY_MIGRATOR_RDS_CONNECTION_STRING)
(optional, for --delete-source: env BINARY_MIGRATOR_RDS_WRITE_CONNECTION_STRING, a login that may UPDATE)
A connection string is never accepted as a plain command-line argument (it contains a password).

options.name: --local-path
options.description:
Root folder of the binary storage   [env BINARY_MIGRATOR_LOCAL_PATH]
(BinaryStorage.json "Path", or App_Data/BinaryStorage of Pleasanter).

options.name: --azure-container
options.description: Container name          [env BINARY_MIGRATOR_AZURE_CONTAINER]

options.name: --azure-account-uri
options.description:
Storage account URI     [env BINARY_MIGRATOR_AZURE_ACCOUNT_URI]
(authenticates with DefaultAzureCredential)

options.name: --azure-connection-string-stdin
options.description:
Use a connection string read from standard input instead.
(default: env BINARY_MIGRATOR_AZURE_CONNECTION_STRING)
Exit codes: 0 = all succeeded, 1 = some items failed or the run was stopped, 2 = invalid arguments.
